threads.body: The first Aurora DSQL test case sets `namespace` but not `name`. In the rest of the file, `.setNamespace(...)` is used mainly when it differs from the database name (e.g., `db|schema`), while `.setName(...)` is used to express the expected database name. For consistency/readability, set `.setName("postgres")` here and let namespace default to the name (or set both explicitly if you want to assert both).

`stripJdbcPrefix` has an explicit special-case for `jdbc:aws-dsql:` but no inline comment explaining the wrapper (unlike the `jdbc:tracing:` branch). Adding a brief note and/or link to the AWS Aurora DSQL JDBC connector docs would make this vendor-specific exception easier to understand and maintain.
